stem: An intervention coincides with crop removal, humidity correction and intensified sanitation. What is the strongest outcome statement if pressure later falls?
choices: Attribute the decline primarily to the treatment because it was the planned intervention and the other changes were supportive conditions.
Attribute the decline primarily to humidity correction because environmental improvement affects pest/pathogen pressure more broadly.
Report that pressure declined after several simultaneous changes and that the contribution of any one intervention cannot be isolated without stronger evidence.
Remove the crop-removal and sanitation details from the trend summary so the treatment effect can be evaluated more directly.
rationale: When crop removal, environmental correction, sanitation, and treatment occur together, the observed decline is a combined outcome. The data may support that the overall response was effective, but they do not isolate which component caused the improvement. A defensible report preserves all concurrent changes and limits causal attribution. Removing other actions from the record would distort the evidence rather than clarify it.
